Act: The Fair Work Act 2009 (Cth), or its successor.
Agreement: The Biomedical Engineers (Victorian Public Sector) (Single Interest Employers) Enterprise Agreement 2024-2028.
Child: Includes an adopted child, step child and ex-nuptial child.
Commission: The Fair Work Commission or any successor body.
Employee: A person employed by an Employer listed in Appendix 1 of this Agreement who is qualified to carry out Professional Engineering Duties and is employed to apply engineering method to the solution of problems in the area of medicine and other life sciences (Biomedical Engineer).
Employer: Each organisation listed in Appendix 1 of this Agreement.
Experienced Engineer: A professional engineer with qualifications at least equal to those of a member of Engineers Australia, with the required years of experience in professional engineering duties.
FFPPOA: First full pay period on or after.
HSR: Health and safety representative (including a deputy health and safety representative).
Immediate Family: A Spouse, Child, parent, grandparent, grandchild or sibling of the Employee; or a child, parent, grandparent, grandchild or sibling of a Spouse of the Employee.
NES: National Employment Standards — Part 2-2 of the Fair Work Act 2009.
Professional Engineering Duties: Duties where the adequate discharge of any portion requires the Employee to hold qualifications at least equal to those of a Graduate member of the Institute of Engineers Australia.
Qualified Engineer: A Biomedical Engineer who is, or is qualified to become, a Graduate member of the Institute of Engineers Australia.
Reasonable Business Grounds: Grounds including but not limited to: too costly; no capacity to change working arrangements; impractical to change working arrangements of other employees; likely to cause a significant loss in efficiency or productivity; or likely to have a significant negative impact on customer service.
Registered Health Practitioner: An individual registered under the Health Practitioner Regulation National Law to practise a health profession, other than as a student.
Regulations: The Fair Work Regulations 2009 (Cth), or its successor.
Spouse: A person to whom an Employee is married, a de facto partner, former spouse, or former de facto partner — someone who lives with the Employee in a genuine domestic relationship as a couple.
Stillborn Child: A child who weighs at least 400 grams at delivery or whose period of gestation was at least 20 weeks, who has not breathed since delivery, and whose heart has not beaten since delivery.
Union: The Association of Professional Engineers, Scientists and Managers, Australia, trading as Professionals Australia.
VHIA: Victorian Hospitals' Industrial Association — the employers' representative body.
WIRC Act: Workplace Injury Rehabilitation and Compensation Act 2013 (Vic), or where applicable the Accident Compensation Act 1985 (Vic) or the Workers Compensation Act 1958 (Vic).
2022 Agreement: The Biomedical Engineers (Victorian Public Sector) Enterprise Agreement 2022-2023.
